adminEventCreatorRoles.title: Event creator roles
adminEventCreatorRoles.description: Members with any of the selected Discord roles can create events and edit the events they created. Leave empty to keep event creation admin-only.
adminEventCreatorRoles.reloginHint: Changes take effect after each user signs in again.

adminActiveMemberRoles.title: Active member roles
adminActiveMemberRoles.description: Members holding any of the selected Discord roles are treated as active. Leave empty to default to the site login roles (DISCORD_MEMBER_ROLE_ID). Members who left the server or hold none of the listed roles are classified as withdrawn and excluded from member lists and aggregates.
adminActiveMemberRoles.cronHint: A daily cron (04:00 KST) checks the Discord member list and updates the flag. Click 'Run sync now' below for an immediate refresh.
adminActiveMemberRoles.syncDescription: Fetch the Discord member list and update active/withdrawn flags right now. Bypasses the 20h cron throttle.

adminBombSquadCallerRoles.title: Bomb squad caller roles
adminBombSquadCallerRoles.description: Members with any of the selected Discord roles can be assigned as the caller for a bomb squad party on the event editor. Callers can approve join requests for their own party.
adminBombSquadCallerRoles.reloginHint: Changes take effect after each user signs in again.

adminRegearLimits.title: Regear submission limits
adminRegearLimits.description: Configure how long we wait for the killboard API to index deaths before submissions open, and how many requests a single member can file per event. Changes apply to submissions from now on.
adminRegearLimits.windowMinutesHint: {min}–{max} minutes. Submissions open this many minutes after battle_started_at — a grace period for the killboard to index deaths.
adminRegearLimits.maxDeathsHint: {min}–{max}. Max regear requests a single member can file per event. Rejected rows don't count — members can retry after a rejection.

adminEventAutoStart.title: Auto-start events
adminEventAutoStart.description: Cron automatically marks battle started for events whose gather_at has passed, opening the regear window at the scheduled time without admin intervention.
adminEventAutoStart.enabledHint: When enabled, the 5-min cron sets battle_started_at = gather_at for events where gather_at ≤ now and battle_started_at is NULL. Only the last 30 minutes are scanned to prevent bulk-starting historical events.

adminRegearPayoutRate.title: Regear payout rate
adminRegearPayoutRate.description: The percentage of each claim that is credited on approval. Payout = claimed × percent ÷ 100 (floor). Default 100%. Changes apply to approvals from now on.
adminRegearPayoutRate.percentHint: {min}–{max}%. Example: at 80%, approving a 10,000-silver claim credits 8,000 silver.
